title: H2O2 Content Measurement in Leaf Tissue
author: Mingxin Guo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jqhcmt6

steps.title: Grow seedlings
steps.instruction: Cultivate seedlings in Kimura’s culture solution B until they reach the six‑leaf stage.

steps.title: Harvest and alkaline treat tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 200 mg of fresh leaf tissue and subject it to alkaline treatment at pH 9.5 for the desired duration (0, 3, or 5 days).

steps.title: Extract tissue in TCA
steps.instruction: Extract the treated leaf tissue in 2.0 mL of 0.1 % (w/v) trichloroacetic acid (TCA) on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the resulting homogenate at 12,000 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: To 0.3 mL of the supernatant, add 0.3 mL of 10 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 7.5).

steps.title: Add potassium iodide
steps.instruction: Add 0.6 mL of 1 M potassium iodide to the mixture prepared in the previous step.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of each sample at 390 nm.

steps.title: Calculate H2O2 content
steps.instruction: Determine H₂O₂ content (nmol g⁻¹ fresh weight) using a standard curve generated from known H₂O₂ concentrations.
